item.title: How a rural Alabama quilting tradition shaped Ralph Lauren’s latest luxury collection
item.description: The Ralph Lauren x Gee’s Bend collection is the brand’s latest collaboration with historic American craft communities. Deep in a curve of the Alabama River is the small rural community of Gee’s Bend. The site of a former cotton plantation where the residents trace their lineage to enslaved ancestors, it has recently become known for some of the most creative abstract art in America. The medium isn’t a canvas or sculpture: It’s the quilt.For centuries, the women of Gee’s Bend faced extreme poverty and isolation. They would save up whatever scraps were on hand—worn out denim workwear, faded rags...
